attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Kentucky military retirement exemption (2025). Flat $31,110 exemption (matches general pension exclusion). SBP payments receive same treatment. Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, KY DOR. Skeleton — see issue #446.

action_details.action_dsl: /* No military retirement pay - no exemption. */

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Kentucky state income tax. Flat 4.00% rate (KRS 141.020, 2025) on AGI minus $3,270 standard deduction (same for all filing statuses). Writes result.ky_taxable_income and result.ky_state_tax.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.ky_state_tax = 0; set result.ky_taxable_income = 0; add " Kentucky Tax Calculation (Form 740) - flat 4.00%" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.ky_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.ky_taxable_income xdef " Kentucky Tax Calculation (Form 740) - flat 4.00%" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Always compute (single-column FIRST table; deduction is uniform)

action_details.action_comment: Compute KY taxable income (AGI − $3,270) and 4.00% tax
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ky_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - ky_standard_deduction) and 0.0; set result.ky_state_tax = result.ky_taxable_income * ky_tax_rate; add " KY taxable income (AGI - $3,270): $" + result.ky_taxable_income to job.audit_trail; add " KY state tax (4.00%): $" + result.ky_state_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi ky_standard_deduction f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ky_taxable_income xdef result.ky_taxable_income ky_tax_rate fmul cvd /result.ky_state_tax xdef " KY taxable income (AGI - $3,270): $" result.ky_taxable_income strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " KY state tax (4.00%): $" result.ky_state_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Publish state result to the generic computed_state_tax fields
action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = result.ky_taxable_income; set result.computed_state_tax = result.ky_state_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.ky_taxable_income cvi /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.ky_state_tax cvi /result.computed_state_tax xdef
